title: Identity-representative affine cohomology edge normalization
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-affine-pushforward-cohomology-edge-exists, there exists the same natural transformation alpha such that the required equation holds for the canonical representative Q(T_A C), with any chosen quasi-coherence proof of that object.

source.place: perfect.tex, affine morphism equivalence proof, identity representative calculation.

proof.text: Obtain the natural sheaf edge epsilon from lem-pc-affine-derived-pushforward-sheaf-edge. Set J = inclusion followed by H^i, and Gamma = affine global sections. Define alpha as J Gamma whiskered with the supplied sigma, followed by J whiskered with the pushforward of the tilde/Gamma counit, followed by epsilon. This is an actual composition of natural transformations.

For the canonical representative let k be the inverse exact-tilde homology comparison followed by the inverse Q/homology comparison. The representative coordinate b is the adjunction unit followed by Gamma(k). Counit naturality and the left triangle identity give T_A(b) followed by the counit equal to k. Apply naturality of sigma to b, functoriality of pushforward, and the sheaf edge normalization at T_A.

The remaining equation is precisely the ordinary comparison factorization: evaluate sigma at H^i(C), then apply the exact homology comparison for T_A followed by pushforward, the Q/homology comparison, and the derived unit. Remove the identity morphisms on the target by functoriality.

theorem exists_affinePushforwardCohomologyEdge_identity
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ)
    (σ : ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B ≅
      affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :
  ∃ α : affineDerivedCohomologyModules A i ⋙
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B) ⟶
    (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i,
    ∀ (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) ℤ)
      (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((affinePushforwardTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))),
      affinePushforwardCohomologyMapOfComparison A B φ σ C i ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i).map
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map
            (𝟙 _)) =
        (affinePushforwardTilde B).map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
          (affinePushforwardRepresentativeCohomologyIso A C _ (Iso.refl _) i).hom) ≫
          α.app ⟨_, hK⟩
